programme.desc: జ్యోతికి పుట్టిన కూతురు అపహరించబడినప్పుడు ఆమె ప్రపంచం ముక్కలవుతుంది.చాలా ఏళ్ల తర్వాత, ఆమె చివరకు తన కూతురిని కలుస్తుంది.

programme.title: నిన్ను కోరి
programme.desc: ఒక గ్రామంలోని గౌరవనీయమైన కుటుంబానికి చెందిన ఒక అమ్మాయి కీర్తి,వ్యక్తిగత విశ్వాసాలను సమతుల్యం చేసుకోవడానికి కష్టపడుతుంది.

programme.title: బ్రహ్మ ముడి
programme.desc: తల్లి సంపన్నులతో తమ పెళ్లి నిశ్చయించడంతో, ముగ్గురు అక్కాచెల్లెళ్ళు ఈ కొత్త పరిస్థితులకు అలవాటు పడడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఇంటింటి రామాయణం
programme.desc: తమ కుటుంబంలో అనేక పోరాటాలను ఎదుర్కొంటున్న అవని, ఆమె భర్త అక్షయ్ లు తమ జీవితంలో తలెత్తే సమస్యలను ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

programme.title: వారసురాలు
programme.desc: ఒకప్పుడు ఐక్యంగా ఉన్న కుటుంబం ఆశయం, నిందల కారణంగా విడిపోతుంది, ఏళ్ళ తర్వాత ఒక కూతురు వారిని తిరిగి కలుపుతుంది.

programme.title: నిండు మనసులు
programme.desc: తమ గతం వలన బాధపడుతున్న ప్రేరణ, సిద్దార్థ్ లకు ఒకరిపై మరొకరికి ఉన్న ప్రేమ తమని తాము తిరిగి కనుగొనడంలో వారికి సాయపడుతుందా?

programme.title: கச்சேரி ஆரம்பம்
programme.desc: தேவைப்படுபவர்களுக்கு உதவ எப்போதும் தயாராக இருக்கும் பாரி, சென்னைக்கு குடிபெயர்ந்தபோது, ஒரு இளம் பெண்ணை காதலிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: லாலிபாப்
programme.desc: பட்டறை ஓட்டும் பிராங்கோ, கல்லூரி செல்லும் தங்கையின் எதிரியை சகோதரன் நேசிக்கிறான் என அறிந்த போது விஷயம் மாறுகிறது.

programme.title: சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.desc: திறமையான இசைக் கலைஞர்கள் தயாரித்து இசையமைத்த பிரபலமான பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பு அடுத்தடுத்து இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: தேனும் பாலும்
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற இசைக்கலைஞர்களால் இசையமைக்கப்பட்டு, தமிழ் திரைப்படங்களில் பல்வேறு கலைஞர்கள் நிகழ்த்திய மெல்லிசை பாடல்கள்.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: ஸ்லாட்
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி தொலைக்காட்சியில் மிகவும் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருகிறது.

programme.title: ஏஆர்சி இன்டர்நேஷனல்
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: ஜீவி
programme.desc: அற்பமான ஒரு புத்திசாலி மனிதன் வாழ்வில் ஏதாவது ஒன்றைச் செய்ய சில நகைகளை திருடி அதிலிருந்து தப்பிக்க முடிவு செய்கிறான்.

programme.title: வம்சம்

programme.title: ஆஃப்ரிக்காஸ் சீக்ரட் க்ரியேச்சர்ஸ்

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Dashing Khiladi 2
programme.desc: A man loves a woman but also faces threats from goons. However, when the gangster murders his friend and kidnaps the woman he loves, he strives to take revenge.

programme.title: Dove
programme.desc: Anoop and Aditi love each other but face an unexpected obstacle when Anoop gets charged with murder. Meanwhile, Kumar and Sona, who share an intimate relationship, try to overcome their challenges.

programme.title: Lafangay Baaz
programme.desc: A tour guide falls in love with a young woman quite unexpectedly. When the girl's parents force her to marry a businessman, the couple fight for their love.

programme.title: Anjala
programme.desc: The members of a family join hands to save their ancestral tea shop from being demolished, even after receiving threats from the government.

programme.title: Gangs of Godavari
programme.desc: An ambitious man named Lankala Rathnakar desires to rise to the top. However, to reach his goal, he must navigate through the murky waters of power and dirty politics.

programme.title: Return of Hanuman
programme.desc: Lord Hanuman reincarnates as Maruti to help Minku, a bullied boy, while addressing challenges of modern life, courage and the importance of protecting nature.

programme.title: DNA
programme.desc: Due to their precarious mental health, Divya and Anand's marriage faces numerous challenges that test their relationship.

programme.title: Sita Ramam
programme.desc: Upon returning to Pakistan, Afreen sets off to fulfil her grandfather's wish of delivering a letter from Ram to Sita. Along the way, she finds Ram and learns about their love story.

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: Nani discovers a rare antique idol from the excavation site at Amaravati. He wants to sell it and keep the money for himself, but before he can do that, the idol goes missing.

programme.title: Khatarnak Policewala
programme.desc: After a priest's murder and a woman's abduction, ACP Vetrimaaran uncovers a ring linked to a fertility clinic. His investigation takes a personal turn when the conspiracy affects his own family.

programme.title: Taqdeer
programme.desc: Soon after Avinash manages to get the phone number of his childhood love Priya, his phone gets stolen by a gangster. So, he sets out on a dangerous chase in order to reconcile with his lover.

programme.title: Khaidi No. 150
programme.desc: Seenu, a criminal, escapes from the prison and places his doppelgänger, Shankar, in his place. However, upon learning about Shankar's noble mission, he takes up the cause himself.
